event:
I submitted the verdict as **verified**. The finding is real but low severity.

The header comment in both param test files says the MCU configures the Caliptra uC as an invalid AXI user. The code in `smoke_test_mcu_mbox_axi_param.c` does not do that. It uses either 0x33333333 (the build-time parameter value) or a randomly chosen entry from `axi_user_id[]`. It then passes that same array as the mailbox valid users.

The test looks like a copy of `smoke_test_mcu_mbox_invalid_axi`. That test calls `mcu_mbox_generate_invalid_axi(axi_user_id)` to produce a genuinely invalid ID, and the stale comment appears to have been carried over.

The in-function comment at lines 77-78 of the param test describes the behaviour correctly. It says the outcome depends on `cfg_caliptra_axi_with_param`, so the header comment is the only part that is wrong.

I did not work out why the Caliptra side expects AXI errors in the non-param case when the ID is in the valid-user array. That doesn't change the comment mismatch.
